bio: Chef Arnaud Tavares is the nomad of the name: he has worked all over the world, from Switzerland to Thailand. Mackerel tempura, silky pumpkin soup, fried ginger and kororima seed; roast hake, bouillabaisse-style foam, aioli, fennel, sobrasada and melba toast; peach poached with verbena, granola, almond espuma and peach gel: our quicksilver globetrotter has a knack for combining flavours and tastes with real energy and flair. He may be a keen traveller, but he also knows how to make the most of local ingredients (organic fruit and vegetables, fish from Lorient's fish market etc). Reasonably priced set menu at lunchtime....
